items.html: And know that there is a difference between the Daat of ZA and the Daat of his Nukva. For the Daat of ZA stands above in his head, deciding between his Hochma and Bina. And the reason is what was explained by us: that the NHY of Ima, the vessels are of Ima, and the Mochin within them are the lights of ZA himself. But the Keter of ZA — its vessel and the lights within it are the lower half of the Tifferet of Ima, and they are borrowed to ZA, to be a Keter in him.
